title: JSON Schema for gtdb_vs_ncbi files
description: Schema for sheets derived from the gtdb_vs_ncbi_*.xlsx files provided by GTDB. These files represent the correspondence between GTDB and NCBI taxa, ordered by degree of polyphyly.

gtdb_taxon.description: Name of the GTDB taxonomic group

n_genomes.description: number of genomes associated with the named taxonomic group

n_ncbi_taxa.description: number of genomes associated with the named taxonomic group

gtdb_taxon.description: Name of the NCBI taxonomic group

score.description: Score in percent to two dp.

rank.description: Taxonomic rank of the named group
